title: Full Progress: CI Runners Shared Pool
hero: Manager for shared self-hosted GitHub Actions runners on your own machines: controller, node agent, web console, CLI and tray in one binary, crsp.
lede: Milestone 1 code was written overnight by cloud agents and is all on main (14 Nov, 03:16 Lisbon). It is tested only against a fake GitHub API; nothing has run on a real machine yet. Task IDs here are tracker IDs; branch labels (CRSP16-CRSP27) are named in each item.
